# Product usage analytics

*Client industry: SaaS | Completed: 2024-01-17 | Evidence id: data_analyst:case:p10*

## The problem
The client was a SaaS product team arguing about feature usage.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using SQL, BigQuery, a free Google dashboard tool. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
